def transform(grid):
    # Split at the solid divider, then mark positions where both panels contain
    # the shared background color. The shared color is the output background.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_div = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    if row_div is not None:
        a, b = grid[:row_div], grid[row_div + 1:]
        common = set(v for r in a for v in r) & set(v for r in b for v in r)
        color = next(iter(common))
        return [[3 if x == color and y == color else color
                 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    col_div = next(j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1)
    a = [r[:col_div] for r in grid]
    b = [r[col_div + 1:] for r in grid]
    common = set(v for r in a for v in r) & set(v for r in b for v in r)
    color = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if x == color and y == color else color
             for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
